subject: maths
question: The average height of 50 students in a class was 105 cm. A group of five students with an average height of 95 cm were admitted to this class. What is the average height (in cm) of the class of 55 students? (correct to the nearest integer)
solution:
**Given:**

Average height of 50 students = 105 cm

Number of students in the new group = 5

Average height of the new group = 95 cm

**Formula Used:**

Average height = Total height of all students / Total number of students

**Calculation:**

Total height of 50 students = 50 × 105 = 5250 cm

Total height of the new group = 5 × 95 = 475 cm

Combined total height = 5250 + 475 = 5725 cm

Total number of students = 50 + 5 = 55

Average height = Combined total height / Total number of students

⇒ Average height = 5725 / 55 ≈ 104 cm

**The average height of the class of 55 students is 104 cm.**
